slides.text:
4 facts about your body
when you reach your goal

1 — Your energy stops
dipping at 3pm

Stable days become normal

2 — Food gets quieter

The cravings that owned you
just fade out

3 — Sleep gets deeper

You wake up before
the alarm

4 — Clothes fit different

But the confidence is
the real change

slides.heading: Getting there is the hard part
slides.body: SOMA reads your sleep, meals and training — and builds the path to your goal, day by day
